Meet Pippin

The heart behind
The Snippitypip.

Experience, creativity and the belief that a little personal attention goes a long way.

Hair stylist. Extension specialist. Scalp practitioner.

A passion for hair.
A care for people.

With over 20 years in hairdressing, Pippin brings knowledge, creativity and technical expertise to every appointment. Her career with the Toni & Guy group includes experience affiliated with Essensuals Toni & Guy in Covent Garden, London, and work throughout Devon and Cornwall.

Since leaving Toni & Guy, she has built her own business around a more personal, one-to-one service. She takes the time to understand each client’s hair, lifestyle and goals, offering thoughtful advice and a warm welcome.

Her work spans technical hair services, advanced cutting and styling, and occasion hair, including bridal hair-ups. Whether you are exploring a new colour, bespoke extensions, mesh integration or scalp care, the focus is on beautiful, manageable results that feel right for you.

Pippin prides herself on outstanding customer service, long-lasting relationships and a loyal clientele. Her care, commitment to continued learning and love of her craft are at the heart of The Snippitypip.

Experience, with a personal touch

Always learning.
Always looking after you.

Continued professional development and personal client care are at the heart of Pippin’s work.

Hair & confidence

Extension specialist.

Pippin works with Nanos, Ultra Tips and Wefts, alongside professional removals. Specialist training in mesh integration gives her another way to help clients explore fuller-looking hair.

Explore hair extensions↗
Scalp care

Hair & Scalp Practitioner.

A trained and certified Hair and Scalp Practitioner, Pippin has completed specialist training with Malibu C Head Lab. She helps clients understand their hair and scalp needs and offers tailored cosmetic care.

Discover scalp therapy↗
Passing it on

A passion for education.

Pippin has achieved her Award in Education and Training (AET), building on her practical experience as she develops The Snippitypip Training Academy.

Step into the academy↗

Her care continues beyond the salon, with personalised aftercare advice and recommendations from professional brands including K18, Malibu C, Beauty Works, Remi Cachet, Olaplex, Wella, L’Oréal and COLOR WOW.
